editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: FXGT is a legit CySEC-regulated broker scoring 4.8/10 from NAFT in 2026. Founded in 2019 as part of GT Group, it offers genuine crypto-native trading — deposit in Bitcoin, trade forex or crypto CFDs with up to 1:1000 leverage, withdraw in USDT. The CySEC entity provides EU clients with ICF protection up to EUR 20,000. But the majority of international clients route through FSA Seychelles or VFSC Vanuatu where oversight is minimal and compensation does not exist. WikiFX lowered its score due to high-volume unresolved complaints, SiteJabber sits at 2.7/5 with withdrawal difficulties dominating reviews, and regulatory warnings from Malaysia SC and NSSMC Ukraine add to the concern. FXGT works if you are an EU client under CySEC or a crypto trader who accepts offshore risk. For everyone else, the complaint pattern is too loud to ignore.
